summary: Safe string formatting wrapper: sets up a size-limited buffer, calls sub_58D04D to format a2/a3 into the a1 buffer, then either NUL-terminates the buffer or invokes sub_58CF35 when the size counter is exhausted. Returns the formatter result.

operations.description: Initializes the format size counter v8 to 0x7FFFFFFF and records the destination buffer v7 from argument a1.
sub_58D04D(&v7, a2, a3) formats arguments a2/a3 into the output buffer; its return value v3 is the result.
After decrementing the size counter (--v8 < 0), decides between failure handling and normal termination.
sub_58CF35(0, &v7): failure/cleanup path invoked when the format size counter is exhausted.
NUL-terminates the output buffer on the normal path (writes 0 at buffer offset 0).
Returns the formatter result v5 (the value returned by sub_58D04D).

unresolved: The size counter is initialized to 0x7FFFFFFF and decremented only once after the formatter call, so it can only trip for a negative return; the exact overflow semantics are unclear.
Role of the local v10 initialized to 66 is unresolved; it is assigned but not otherwise used in the decompiled body.
Prelabel naming is cluster-derived (structural twin of ObjectAllocator) at DERIVED trust only; owner class is unknown.
